liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Queen Jane Approximately** (2 reviews): Brent takes a wild piano solo in Queen Jane; Brent's solo in Queen Jane was so intense it supposedly hurt many people in attendance [14][15]
- **Bertha** (1 review): Bertha into Greatest Story opened a rocking first set, with an energetic Jerry [13]
- **Greatest Story Ever Told** (1 review): Reviewer vividly remembers how this song ended [12]
- **Built To Last** (1 review): Reviewer found Built To Last excellent [21]
- **Crazy Fingers** (1 review): Reviewer especially liked this Crazy Fingers [20]
- **Eyes Of The World** (1 review): Reviewer finds this Eyes too fast [20]
- **Space** (1 review): Space features a sweet MIDI solo from Jerry [13]
- **Stella Blue** (1 review): Reviewer ranks this Stella Blue among the best versions ever played [11]

## The recordings

- **gd89-08-04.sbd.11267.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 23 songs; 163 min; rated 4.48/5 by 23 [1]. Said about its sound: The reviewer says the soundboard recording sounds pretty good [10]
- **gd1989-08-04.163489.ultramatrix.miller.flac2496**: soundboard; 23 songs; 166 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [2]. Said about its sound: There is PA static at the end of Never Trust A Woman [2]
- **gd1989-08-04.164156.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.t.flac1644**: soundboard; 23 songs; 166 min [4]. Said about its sound: There is PA static at the end of Never Trust A Woman [4]
- **gd1989-08-04.177547.nak700.neumann.km84i.blend.bradt.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 23 songs; 160 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [5]

## Around the show

- The first set ran so long that the reviewer remembered thinking it was the whole show [10]
- This was the reviewer's first Grateful Dead concert [12]
- Fans near the soundboard sang Happy Birthday to Jerry during Space, and the singing can be faintly heard on the tape [13]
- Reviewer brought their baby, the day after her first birthday; people smoked throughout the outdoor show [16]
- The Cal Expo parking lot was a free-wheeling, sunny, protected scene for three full days, with endless jamming [18]
- Reviewer puts it in the top five of 1989, though overshadowed by the preceding Alpine shows [14]
- Reviewer calls it the last truly free parking-lot scene they remember, fading soon afterward [18]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd89-08-04.sbd.11267.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD > MC > DAT > CDR [1]. Also: Soundboard to MC to DAT to CDR; seeded to etree by Doug Nawrocki [1]
- **gd1989-08-04.163489.ultramatrix.miller.flac2496**: taped by Recorded by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  January 31, 2023; source: UltraMatrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK MA-XG90/TDK SA-X90) [2]. Also: Recorded by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; several masters were combined to complete the show [2]
- **gd1989-08-04.164156.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.t.flac1644**: taped by Recorded by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  January 31, 2023; source: UltraMatrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK MA-XG90/TDK SA-X90) [4]. Also: Recorded by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; several masters combined; this is a 24/96 to 16/44.1 conversion [4]
- **gd1989-08-04.177547.nak700.neumann.km84i.blend.bradt.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Bill Bradt; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Bill Bradt's Master Audience Cassettes; Nakamichi 700 (Left/Right) + Neumann KM84i (Center) blend > unknown mixer > Sony D5M (TDK SD-90) [5]. Also: Master cassettes came from Bill and Kathy Weir Bradt; Charlie Miller handled the transfer and coordination; Nak 700 and Neumann KM84i blend; a Schoeps CMC44 source from Ted Mattes and Lance Deal patches the Drums to Space transition [5]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by antelopecrossing.blogspot.com: [more GRATEFUL DEAD SBDs 1989](https://antelopecrossing.blogspot.com/2010/12/more-grateful-dead-sbds-1989.html) [23]
- Poster by Wolfgang's: [Grateful Dead Laminate from Cal Expo Amphitheater, Aug 4, 1989 at Wolfgang's](https://www.wolfgangs.com/backstage-passes/grateful-dead/laminate/CLX890804.html) [24]
- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [1989-08-04 Grateful Dead Backstage Pass - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/image/1989-08-04-grateful-dead-backstage-pass/) [25]
